messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High - single-tenant quality regression detected for tenant orion-9001 (tenant_id: orion-9001). Affected model: redwood-4b-quant (profile: q5_thrift). Pool: dedicated-useast1-32. Symptoms: abrupt truncation, hallucinations, incoherent legal clause completions. Alert triggered ~2026-04-10T09:12Z. Paging eng-ml + eng-platform + eng-sre + customer-success.

maya (oncall): Ack. I'll coordinate. @pavel @jo @liu triage please. I'll collect impact and own comms to the customer until handoff.

pavel (eng-ml): Looking. We rolled q5_thrift to that pool at 09:05Z as part of cost-sweep. Initial local repro against the tenant's canonical set shows large drop in semantic similarity and shorter token outputs. Hypothesis: the quant clamp in q5_thrift reduces effective context in some long-prompt patterns.

jo (eng-platform): Control-plane shows the rollout completed at 09:05:18Z. For dedicated pools we can apply a tenant override to revert quant_profile -> q8_stable. I will prepare a staged rollback (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Need eng-sre ACL clearance to write overrides on that pool.

liu (eng-sre): No 5xx or infra errors. This is quality-only but P2 due to enterprise SLA. I approve the temporary ACL window for platform to perform the tenant-scoped override; will ensure audit logging.

rachel (customer-success): Notified Orion infra lead. They report truncated legal clauses in production. Asked for ETA and whether they should pause jobs. I'll keep them on soft hold.

pavel (eng-ml): Proposed mitigation steps:
1) Apply tenant-scoped override: quant_profile = q8_stable for orion-9001 on dedicated-useast1-32 (staged rollout).
2) If override delayed: route tenant traffic to hosted-fallback-useast1-fp16 with tenant-isolation and audit logs.
3) After rollback: run 1k request smoke test across canonical prompts + 5k sampled production calls for parity checks.
4) Postmortem + gating updates: require tenant-canonical prompts in quant rollout canaries.

jo (eng-platform): Preparing override command (running with ops creds):

```
# control-plane API example
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood.internal/tenants/orion-9001/overrides" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RWCTL" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-4b","quant_profile":"q8_stable","staged":true,"note":"rollback q5_thrift - mitigate tenant regression 2026-04-10"}'

# rwctl
rwctl tenant override set --tenant orion-9001 --model redwood-4b --profile q8_stable --pool dedicated-useast1-32 --staged
```

liu (eng-sre): Make sure staged override includes tenant.isolated=true and disables cross-tenant KV caching. Enable verbose audit logs for the operation window.

jo (eng-platform): Step 1: 5% staged override applied at 2009998930 (op-id 0xbeef12). Routing logs show 5% of Orion sessions now hitting q8_stable. Monitoring semantic-sim, token counts, and truncation events.

pavel (eng-ml): Early A/B from 5% bucket: completion length recovered ~30% and hallucination rate down significantly. Encouraging.

jo (eng-platform): Step 2: 25% applied at 2009999005. No routing errors; latency stable (+4ms median). No tokenization anomalies.

rachel (customer-success): Sent update to Orion: "We detected a configuration-driven regression and are performing a tenant-scoped rollback. Expect progressive mitigation within ~15 minutes. No data has been exported; actions are tenant-scoped and audited." Customer replied: "Proceed. Keep us posted." :thumbsup:

jo (eng-platform): Step 3: 100% applied at 2009999120. Override persisted and all Orion traffic now maps to q8_stable. Smoke test: 1k canonical prompts, pass rate 98.2% vs baseline.

pavel (eng-ml): Running extended checks: 5k sampled production calls show semantic similarity within baseline +/-0.02. We'll monitor for 2 hours.

liu (eng-sre): Created incident record INC-2009998001 and linked relevant runbooks (quant-rollout, tenant-overrides). ACL audit logs stored under op-id 0xbeef12.

maya (oncall): Handoff to pavel for RCA and postmortem ownership. Summary: q5_thrift quant profile rollout caused tenant-specific semantic regressions for Orion-Lex on dedicated-useast1-32. Mitigation: tenant override to q8_stable staged to 100% and pinned. No 5xx, no data leakage. Customer notified. Pavel to own RCA and follow-ups.

pavel (eng-ml): Acknowledged. Immediate action items:
- P0: keep orion-9001 pinned to q8_stable until RCA and safe re-roll (pavel)
- P1: add Orion canonical prompts to the quant rollout canary suite (eng-ml + eng-platform)
- P2: implement per-tenant semantic-drift alerts (embedding/length/hallucination) with auto-rollback runbook (eng-ml)
- P3: document quant-profile changes and require tenant-impact checks for dedicated pools (eng-platform)

omar (account): Sharing mitigation summary with Orion execs. They requested the QA dump and a tentative date for postmortem. I'll coordinate delivery with rachel.

devops-bot: STATUS CHANGE: mitigated -> monitoring. Mitigated at 2009999142. Incident duration ~30m. Postmortem owner: pavel. Next steps: RCA, canary inclusion, gating improvements.

maya (oncall): "Closing pager. Reopen if any regression or customer report arises. Thanks everyone for the quick response."
